annotations.title: Ask the user to step in

description: Hands an open session to the Writ user: kind='captcha' (they complete a security check in the live browser), 'twofa' (they supply the one-time code and Writ types it; the code never reaches this conversation), 'sign_in' (they sign in on the live page; no persona applies) or 'question' (their text answer). The call that opens the ask returns at once with user_link + tell_user to relay; later calls hold up to 60 s and answer answered, waiting_for_user (the same call again) or expired. Their answer is kept if your turn ends first.
name: writ_browser_ask_user
title: Ask the user to step in
